## Methods

The cumulative incidence of each event type (status = 1, 2; 0 = censored) was estimated with the Aalen-Johansen estimator in each group of arm (intensified, n = 100; standard, n = 100), which treats the other event types as competing events rather than as censoring. The event type of interest is status = 1. The groups were compared for each event type with Gray's k-sample test (rho = 0): status = 1, chi-square(1) = 5.15, P = 0.023; status = 2, chi-square(1) = 10.98, P < 0.001. The cumulative incidence at months = 20, 30 and 50 is given in the stats table, and the number at risk (the subjects with a follow-up time of t or more) is shown below each panel. Computed in R 4.4.1 with cmprsk 2.2.12 and drawn with ggplot2 3.5.1.
